# Climb Global Solutions Acquires NeoVAD, Building Greater Scale in France


October 22, 2026 8:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_7260dba81f3e7a8d2f472cab6fa3deec/waysidetechnology/news/2026-10-22_Climb_Global_Solutions_Acquires_NeoVAD_Building_249.pdf)


*Acquisition Expands Climb’s European Platform and Deepens Strategic Vendor Relationships*


*Transaction Expected to be Accretive to Earnings and Adjusted EBITDA*


EATONTOWN, N.J., Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Climb Global Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ:CLMB) (“Climb” or the “Company”), a value-added global IT channel company providing unique sales and distribution solutions for innovative technology vendors, has completed the acquisition of NeoVAD, a France-based value-added IT distributor focused on cybersecurity, cloud services and virtualization, serving reseller partners across the French market, for an aggregate purchase price of approximately €16.0 million ($18.0 million1).


NeoVAD brings its established presence in France to Climb with approximately 300 active resellers and vendor relationships including Cato Networks, DataCore and Netwrix, among others. For its fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, NeoVAD generated EBITDA of approximately €2.2 million2 ($2.5 million)3, which was up 487% from approximately €378,0002 ($427,000)3 the prior fiscal year.


**Management Commentary**


“NeoVAD is a strong fit with our strategy to continue expanding Climb’s scale and capabilities across Europe,” said Climb CEO Dale Foster. “The acquisition adds meaningful reach in France while strengthening several important vendor relationships and creating opportunities to bring more of Climb’s portfolio to NeoVAD’s reseller network. At the same time, NeoVAD’s established position in France can help us build greater depth with vendors including Cato Networks, DataCore and Netwrix across our broader platform. We also see a meaningful opportunity to expand our Microsoft distribution business by pairing our existing EMEA capabilities with NeoVAD’s local training and technical support expertise. We expect this acquisition to be accretive to earnings and adjusted EBITDA, while NeoVAD’s stronger margin profile further supports our profitability objectives and expands our European platform for continued growth.”


Commenting on the acquisition, NeoVAD Founder and CEO Jérôme Boulon stated: “For more than a decade, we have built NeoVAD around a focused portfolio of cybersecurity, cloud and virtualization solutions and a high-touch model designed to help resellers successfully bring those technologies to market. Climb shares our focus on specialized, value-added distribution and brings broader scale and capabilities that can help us build on what we have established in France. We see significant opportunity to expand the solutions we bring to our reseller partners while creating additional opportunities for our vendors across Climb’s European platform.”


Additional information can be found in Climb’s Current Report on Form 8-K to be filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on October 22, 2026.


**About Climb Global Solutions**


Climb Global Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ:CLMB) is a value-added global IT distribution and solutions company specializing in emerging and innovative technologies. Climb operates across the U.S., Canada and Europe through multiple business units, including Climb Channel Solutions, Grey Matter and Climb Global Services. The Company provides IT distribution and solutions for companies in the Security, Data Management, Connectivity, Storage & HCI, Virtualization & Cloud, and Software & ALM industries.


Additional information can be found by visiting[www.climbglobalsolutions.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=OuGiQ3AB_dTJ_65h_8xmrgZ6KmL_UfrUOCNQOWDq3OndiCCB5iYHSAabpQHh7CZjlalIa3Y6xkXSLcuK-3yEzkVWtlR-1avOIddi6qJmS2USWIPVaWdlSdRwuIKEYF2o) .


**About NeoVAD**


NeoVAD is a value-added IT distributor headquartered in Boulogne-Billancourt, France, serving reseller partners across the French market. The company specializes in cybersecurity, cloud services and virtualization solutions and maintains relationships with technology vendors including Cato Networks, DataCore and Netwrix, among others. NeoVAD operates a fully indirect, two-tier distribution model supporting approximately 300 active resellers, integrators and MSPs. Through its high-touch approach, the company provides presales, technical training, marketing and demand-generation support designed to help partners successfully bring vendor solutions to market.
